objectives.en: You can reply to an unhappy customer: thank, apologise and explain.
objectives.vi: Bạn trả lời được khách hàng không hài lòng: cảm ơn, xin lỗi và giải thích.

objectives.en: You can say what will happen next, with dates, and offer something.
objectives.vi: Bạn nói rõ bước tiếp theo, có mốc thời gian, và đưa ra đề xuất bù đắp.

objectives.en: You can follow up politely when someone has not replied.
objectives.vi: Bạn viết được email nhắc lại lịch sự khi chưa nhận được phản hồi.

heading.vi: Cảm ơn, xin lỗi, giải thích

body.en:
Start by **thanking** the customer for writing: **Thank you for your email regarding…** It shows you value their message.
Then **apologise** for the specific problem, not in general: **We sincerely apologise for the delay in delivering your order.**
Give a short, honest **reason** without blaming others: **This was caused by a problem with our warehouse system.** Do not write "It is not our fault".
body.vi:
Mở đầu bằng **cảm ơn** khách đã viết: **Thank you for your email regarding…** Thể hiện bạn trân trọng thư của họ.
Sau đó **xin lỗi** về đúng vấn đề, không chung chung: **We sincerely apologise for the delay in delivering your order.**
Đưa **lý do** ngắn, trung thực, không đổ lỗi: **This was caused by a problem with our warehouse system.** Đừng viết "It is not our fault".

heading.vi: Bước tiếp theo và đề xuất bù đắp

body.en:
Customers want to know **what happens now**. Be specific: **Your order was sent today and will arrive by Thursday 14 November.**
Add a goodwill **offer** if it fits: **As an apology, we have refunded the delivery charge / attached a 15% discount code.**
Close by inviting contact: **If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.**
Use **we** for the company and **I** for what you personally will do.
body.vi:
Khách muốn biết **giờ sẽ thế nào**. Hãy cụ thể: **Your order was sent today and will arrive by Thursday 14 November.**
Thêm **đề xuất** thiện chí nếu phù hợp: **As an apology, we have refunded the delivery charge / attached a 15% discount code.**
Kết bằng lời mời liên hệ: **If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.**
Dùng **we** cho công ty và **I** cho việc chính bạn sẽ làm.

heading.vi: Nhắc lại mà không bất lịch sự

body.en:
When someone has not replied, remind them **politely** and make it easy to answer:
- **I am writing to follow up on** my email of 3 November about…
- **I understand you are very busy, but** I would appreciate an update **by** Friday.
- Repeat the key question in one line.
Avoid "Why haven't you answered?" or "As I already told you…". They sound angry.
body.vi:
Khi chưa có phản hồi, hãy nhắc **lịch sự** và giúp người kia dễ trả lời:
- **I am writing to follow up on** my email of 3 November about…
- **I understand you are very busy, but** I would appreciate an update **by** Friday.
- Nhắc lại câu hỏi chính trong một dòng.
Tránh "Why haven't you answered?" hoặc "As I already told you…". Nghe như đang bực.

situation.en: Khanh works at an online bookshop. A customer, Mr Brown, complained that his order arrived late and one book was missing.
situation.vi: Khánh làm ở một hiệu sách online. Khách hàng Mr Brown phàn nàn đơn hàng giao trễ và thiếu một cuốn.

model.subject: RE: Late and incomplete order no. 30551

note.en: Use the customer's name: it feels personal.
note.vi: Dùng tên khách: tạo cảm giác được quan tâm riêng.

parts.text: Thank you for your email regarding order no. 30551.

note.en: Thank first, and mention the order so he knows you checked.
note.vi: Cảm ơn trước, và nhắc mã đơn để khách biết bạn đã kiểm tra.

parts.text: We sincerely apologise that your parcel arrived four days late and without the book 'The Silent Sea'. This was caused by a stock error in our warehouse.

note.en: A specific apology and an honest reason, with no blame on others.
note.vi: Xin lỗi cụ thể và lý do trung thực, không đổ lỗi.

parts.text: I have sent the missing book by express delivery today, and it will arrive by Wednesday 13 November. You will receive a tracking number by email this afternoon.

note.en: What I have done, a date, and how he can check.
note.vi: Việc tôi đã làm, mốc thời gian, và cách khách kiểm tra.

parts.text: As an apology, we have refunded your delivery charge of $5.

note.vi: Một cử chỉ thiện chí nhỏ, cụ thể.

parts.text:
If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Kind regards,
Dang Quoc Khanh
Customer Service, PageTurn Books

note.en: Invites contact; signs with name, role and company.
note.vi: Mời liên hệ; ký tên kèm chức vụ và công ty.

items: Thank you for your email regarding…
Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

items: We will contact you as soon as…
We would like to offer you…
I have attached a discount code for your next order.

prompt.en: Which is the best first line in a reply to a complaint?
prompt.vi: Câu đầu nào tốt nhất khi trả lời thư phàn nàn?

options: Thank you for your email regarding your recent order.

explanation.en: Thanking first shows you value the customer.
explanation.vi: Cảm ơn trước cho thấy bạn trân trọng khách.

prompt.vi: Lời xin lỗi nào tốt nhất?

options: We sincerely apologise for the delay in delivering your order.
Sorry, but the courier was slow, not us.

explanation.en: Specific and takes responsibility, without blaming others.
explanation.vi: Cụ thể và nhận trách nhiệm, không đổ lỗi.

prompt.en: Which sentence gives a clear next step?
prompt.vi: Câu nào nêu rõ bước tiếp theo?

options: Your replacement will arrive by Friday 15 November.
Maybe we can do something later.

explanation.en: It says what will happen and when.
explanation.vi: Nói rõ chuyện gì sẽ xảy ra và khi nào.

prompt.vi: Câu nhắc lại nào lịch sự?

options: Why haven't you answered my email?
As I already told you, I need this now.
I am writing to follow up on my email of 5 November. I would appreciate an update by Friday.

explanation.en: Refers to the earlier email and gives a polite deadline.
explanation.vi: Nhắc tới email trước và nêu hạn một cách lịch sự.

prompt.en: Put the reply to the customer in order.
prompt.vi: Sắp xếp thư trả lời khách hàng.

parts: Thank you for your email about your hotel booking.
We sincerely apologise that your room was not ready on arrival.
As an apology, we have refunded the first night of your stay.

explanation.vi: Chào → cảm ơn → xin lỗi → đề xuất → ký tên.

task.title: Reply to an unhappy customer
task.instructions: Reply to the customer. Thank them and apologise for the specific problem. Briefly explain the cause. Say what you will do next, with a date, and offer something as an apology. Close professionally.
task.prompt: You work in customer service for FitPro, a company that sells fitness equipment. Reply to the email below.

email.subject: Treadmill still not delivered
email.body:
Hello,

I ordered a treadmill (order no. FP-2291) three weeks ago and paid for delivery within 7 days. It still has not arrived, and nobody has answered my two phone calls. I am very disappointed. Please tell me when I will receive it.

Laura Chen

label.en: Thanks the customer and apologises for the specific problem
label.vi: Cảm ơn khách và xin lỗi đúng vấn đề cụ thể

label.en: Gives a brief, honest reason without blaming others
label.vi: Đưa lý do ngắn, trung thực, không đổ lỗi

label.en: Says clearly what will happen next, with a date
label.vi: Nói rõ bước tiếp theo, có mốc thời gian

label.en: Offers something as an apology and closes professionally
label.vi: Đưa ra đề xuất bù đắp và kết thư chuyên nghiệp
